Where to stay in Florence

Every area rated for day and night, with the reasoning and the sources behind each rating. The map is below the table.

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 74 areas reviewed individually Methodology →

For a short stay in Florence, the areas this map rates best are Centro Storico (Duomo, Signoria), Boboli (Giardino di Boboli) and Santo Spirito (Oltrarno). Each is picked from the ratings and the sights below, not chosen by hand — the reasoning is on the card.
